instructions:
# Public-service catalog

Use **TaskList** for a multi-step service where each step has a status: it is the GOV.UK Task list pattern, and it tells the user what is done, what is next and what cannot start yet. Never simulate it with a bullet list.

Use **SummaryList** for the facts of a case (dates, reference numbers, status): label/value pairs, the GOV.UK Summary list. Never use a table for two columns of facts.

One primary Button per surface. Status words travel in text, never in colour alone.

TaskList.description: A list of the steps of a service, each with a status. GOV.UK Task list.

items.description: Path to a list of { name, status, hint?, locked? } objects.

SummaryList.description: Label/value pairs describing one case or record. GOV.UK Summary list.

items.description: Path to a list of { label, value } objects.

formatString.description: Interpolates data-model values into a template string.
